subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should Control UI replies become a structured `chat.send`/runtime-context contract now, and should this umbrella stay open while the reply-context and final-fallback contracts are reviewed?
rationale: The remaining work changes Gateway protocol/runtime metadata semantics and overlaps an open maintainer-owned final fallback contract, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella for contract review
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Control UI reply metadata contract and align it with the open final-fallback work.

options.title: Split to narrower canonical items
options.body: Close this later only after maintainers explicitly move the Control UI reply-target work and no-output fallback work to separate canonical issues.

options.title: Scope only to Control UI reply metadata
options.body: Treat the fallback wording as owned entirely by the final-fallback issue and narrow this issue to adding structured Control UI reply metadata.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella for contract review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the Control UI reply metadata contract and align it with the open final-fallback work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history on the Control UI reply feature makes this the best available owner for the UI/protocol boundary choice, with fallback input from osolmaz's canonical item.
